🔗 Connect AI Services
All keys are stored locally in your browser only — never sent to GitHub or any third-party server.
Your personal Cloudflare Worker proxies all AI calls. API keys stay on your server — never exposed in the browser. 📖 How to set this up →
Key is saved in your browser only (localStorage). It is sent directly to Google's servers — never to any proxy. Use aistudio.google.com/apikey to create a key.
Key is saved in your browser only. Sent directly to OpenAI's servers. Get your key at platform.openai.com/api-keys.
Custom OpenAI-compatible API endpoint (e.g. Groq, Mistral, local LLM). Must support /v1/chat/completions.
